title: Flapping Airplanes Raises $1B Series A at $6B Valuation
summary:
Index and Lux led a capital injection for Flapping Airplanes to accelerate the development of a more cost-effective approach to machine learning. The startup secured $1 billion in a Series A round, valuing the company at $6 billion, to build tools that allow AI models to be trained on less data and less compute.

The company is creating GPU primitives and methods to increase the performance of hardware from investor Nvidia. By improving chip efficiency, Flapping Airplanes intends to reduce the expenses and hardware requirements associated with training large-scale models to reshape the industry's cost structure.
